🧱 ColumnsPuzzle

Colored gems fall in columns, and when three or more in a row match vertically, they disappear and score points. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Place falling column-shaped pieces into the grid.
  2. Match 3 or more gems of the same color vertically to clear them.
  3. Cleared gems cause remaining gems to fall, potentially triggering combos.
  4. Strategically place pieces to set up vertical matches in advance.
  5. The grid fills up over time — plan ahead to avoid game over.
